name: praxis
description: An engineering operating system for coding agents: discussion, artifacts, lifecycle, documentation, agent guidance, worktrees, execution, review, verification, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: A disciplined engineering workflow for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Praxis is a disciplined operating system for agentic software work, from discussion and planning through durable artifacts, documentation, agent guidance, lifecycle state, worktree isolation, execution, review, verification, and delivery. Praxis defaults local artifacts and worktrees to .agents/ while respecting repository conventions such as Linear, GitHub issues, or committed documentation.
defaultPrompt: Use Praxis for this engineering task.
Let's plan and build this with Praxis.
Use Praxis to continue this work.
